summary: Root cause is migration 0024 (not 0018) vs test traffic: 0024 holds AccessExclusive on receivables then wants payables while traffic holds AccessShare on payables and its INSERT FK trigger wants RowShare on receivables (base 6/20 serial, 12/21 concurrent failures); fix in migration-runner: lock_timeout=floor(deadlock_timeout/2) on every ordinary migration txn and 0018 lock phase plus bounded whole-unit retry on 55P03/40P01, with two new deterministic oracles; prototype passed 30/30 serial, 21/21 concurrent and the full 271-test integration suite
